section: Methods / LoF burden test in the All of Us cohort

review.use_summary: Selected high-confidence loss-of-function sites using Ensembl VEP with LOFTEE for the All of Us rare-variant burden analysis; restricted analyzed variants to MAF <1%.
review.implementation_scope_note: Exact VEP/LOFTEE versions and reference resources are unspecified. Cohort/MCH filtering, covariates and subsequent burden testing are separate study operations; no rare-variant threshold or cohort definition is inferred by LOFTEE.

section: Methods / UKB and All of Us WES data meta-analysis

review.use_summary: Annotated variants pooled from UKB and All of Us with VEP105 and reported LOFTEE GRCh38 v.1.04, grouping them as loss-of-function, missense or synonymous before constructing the LD matrix.
review.implementation_scope_note: The cited BRaVa pipeline is an annotation resource, not a specified immutable container digest. Its current resource revisions do not identify the paper execution. No confidence cutoff or transcript selection absent from this paragraph is invented. Cohort-specific GRM and association models remain separate.

review.use_summary: Used high-confidence LOFTEE loss-of-function predictions in the coding_filter1 rare-variant mask, with separate qualifying missense variants; retained the coding set when adding regulatory variants for coding_noncoding_filter1.
review.implementation_scope_note: GENCODE v29, MAF <0.01, cumulative MAC >=20 and aggregation-wise Bonferroni testing are paper choices. MetaSV, GeneHancer, Fathmm-XF and regulatory annotations are additional mask components. Exact LOFTEE release/resources and newly executed versus supplied annotation provenance are unspecified.

section: Methods / Variant filtering and annotation / Variant annotation

review.use_summary: Included LOFTEE with VEP94.5 and classified canonical-transcript variants using high-confidence LoF calls; placed low-confidence LoF calls in the separate functional-variant category.
review.implementation_scope_note: Preserve the paper's LoF consequence list, including stop_lost and transcript_ablation, while still requiring the reported HC annotation; do not manufacture an HC call from consequence alone. LOFTEE release is unspecified. SpliceAI cutoffs and canonical-transcript classification are separate study rules; LC is not universally discarded.

review.use_summary: Used LOFTEE v.1.04_GRCh38 with VEP105 to annotate exome loss-of-function confidence, selecting MANE Select protein-coding transcripts with GENCODE v39 canonical fallback for downstream variant categories.
review.implementation_scope_note: dbNSFP4.3, CADD1.6, REVEL and SpliceAI1.3 remain distinct resources/methods. The cited floating pipeline now advertises changed resources; do not silently substitute dbNSFP5.4a/CADD1.7 or claim its current container is the paper image. Transcript selection occurs after annotation and must remain explicit.

section: Material and methods / Preparation of UKB data / Whole-exome sequencing data

review.use_summary: Filtered low-confidence LOFTEE calls from protein-truncating variants annotated with VEP109.3, then retained the most severe consequence per variant-gene pair.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paper considers consequences from any transcript; do not replace this with canonical/MANE-only selection. Its PTV class contains splice acceptor/donor, stop-gained and frameshift variants, while stop-lost is in its missense class. LOFTEE version/resources are unreported; read/genotype filtering and PolyPhen/SIFT classes are separate.

review.use_summary: Used LOFTEE v1.04 with VEP105 to classify protein-truncating variants as high- or low-confidence loss-of-function calls before hierarchical variant categorization.
review.implementation_scope_note: MANE Select is preferred with GENCODE v39 canonical fallback. dbNSFP4.3 CADD/REVEL and separate SpliceAI1.3 annotations are additional inputs. Confidence alone does not reproduce the hierarchy, paper burden groups or association tests. The source reports1.04; a precise paper plugin commit/image digest is not supplied.

section: Material and methods / Variant consequence annotation

review.use_summary: Used LOFTEE v1.04 GRCh38 with VEP105 for exome loss-of-function confidence before defining gene-testing categories, using MANE Select protein-coding transcripts and GENCODE v39 canonical fallback.
review.implementation_scope_note: Keep dbNSFP4.3, CADD1.6, REVEL and SpliceAI1.3 distinct from LOFTEE. The later combined high-confidence pLoF/damaging definition and rare-variant gene tests use multiple methods; LOFTEE alone does not implement those masks or tests. Current changes to the cited floating pipeline do not establish the original execution profile.
